iterations.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Deliver a polished PREVIEW BOARD only, with two separate views of this same existing website: a large desktop view on LEFT and a narrow mobile view on RIGHT, separated by a slim dark navy gutter. Image 1 is the existing desktop opening screenshot, Image 2 is the existing mobile opening screenshot. Image 3 is the currently restored otter illustration and is the EXACT otter identity and illustration-style reference. Preserve both website compositions, dark navy/slate/icy ivory palette, painted water and coastline, title typography and wording 'A little deeper.', distant seal on rock, two small birds, bottom scroll/swipe cues and small circular pause controls. Do not redesign or add elements. Make ONE change in BOTH views: the sea otter is now gently treading/peeking up through the ocean, with ONLY its HEAD, short NECK and a SMALL amount of UPPER CHEST/SHOULDERS visible ABOVE the water. The rest of its body is completely submerged. This must be a new upright floating pose, not a crop of a horizontal lying-down otter. Absolutely NO exposed belly, full body, hind feet, flippers, tail or forepaws/hands. Keep the original otter's face, small round ears, dark nose, blue-gray fur, pale silver cheek/muzzle, calm expression and painted illustrative style. Face slightly upward/left toward open space as in the original face; do not introduce a different cartoon animal. Water crosses naturally just below the shoulders/upper chest; a few dark-blue and cool silver ripples wrap AROUND that waterline and pass in front of the submerged chest, making convincing immersion with no sticker edge or rectangular cutout. The visible above-water shape should be mostly the head (about 70% of its height) plus a little upper chest (30%). Retain roughly the existing HEAD SIZE, rather than enlarging the new partial animal to the former whole-body width. Desktop: otter stays in the right-hand water, with head about 180–220px wide relative to a 1440px desktop screenshot and waterline around the lower-middle. Mobile: otter stays in the lower-half water beneath the title, head around 115–140px wide relative to a 390px phone screenshot, waterline around 65–70% of screen height. Enough surrounding water is visible to read the new pose. Keep all title/cue space unobstructed. No title labels for the board, no device frames, no extra texts, no new assets or backgrounds. This is a static concept preview, not a browser implementation.
iterations.decision: Refined to restore desktop seal/gulls and reduce phone otter scale.
